original_ai_output.title_zh: 南非外长称特朗普接收阿非利卡人为“基于种族的政策”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非外长罗纳德·拉莫拉在纽约联合国大会期间接受法国24电视台采访时表示，美国计划接收最多17500名南非白人（阿非利卡人）是“基于种族的政策”，并称所谓阿非利卡人遭“种族灭绝”的说法是“假新闻”。拉莫拉称南非不会干涉该美国项目。他还表示，尽管特朗普政府施压，南非仍坚持就加沙战争在国际法院对以色列提起的种族灭绝诉讼。

location.raw_text: on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York

key_facts.fact: 南非外长拉莫拉称美国接收阿非利卡人的计划是“基于种族的政策”
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said Washington's plan to take in up to 17,500 more White South Africans was "a race-based policy"

key_facts.fact: 拉莫拉称所谓阿非利卡人遭“种族灭绝”是“假新闻”
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: dismissing the "so-called genocide" of Afrikaners as "fake news"

key_facts.fact: 南非不会干涉美国的该项目
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Pretoria will "not interfere" with the US programme, Lamola said

key_facts.fact: 南非坚持在国际法院对以色列的种族灭绝诉讼
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Africa stands by its genocide case against Israel at the International Court of Justice over the war in Gaza

key_facts.fact: 拉莫拉拒绝尼日利亚就南非排外暴力事件的指控，称袭击非国家支持而是治安团体所为
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Lamola rejected Nigeria's accusations over recent anti-foreigner violence in South Africa as "a very unfortunate characterisation", saying the attacks were "not state sponsored" but the "activities of vigilante groups"

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源（法国24电视台），尚无其他来源交叉验证
美国接收阿非利卡人计划的具体规模（最多17500人）为外长转述，未获独立确认
